assumptions: One Slurm node on a shared partition
Apptainer available on compute nodes via center module policy
Loopback coordinator communication is permitted on the compute node
limitations: This run validates single-node execution only; multi-node networking is out of scope

The scheduler stdout records the application success line and cleanup-trap termination; the literal Slurm COMPLETED state is corroborated by reaching the final pipeline step rather than printed explicitly
Validates the v0.1.0 image digest only; a rebuilt image requires revalidation
portabilityBoundaries: Scheduler account and partition are supplied at submission time
Apptainer availability depends on center module policy
Job-scoped scratch source varies by center ($SLURM_TMPDIR vs derived $SCRATCH)
Shared-partition loopback and exclusive step behavior are site-dependent
